_comment: Cost + time-to-effect rates used by GC-1 autonomous replenishment planner. Inputs to /pulse/recommend-actions when ranking cannibalization / expedite / cross-level / redistribute options. Values are order-of-magnitude plausible, not authoritative DLA rates.

cannibalize.description: Transfer a part from one deadlined asset to another within the same fleet.
cannibalize.risk_note: Donor stays deadlined; audit chain must preserve removal event.

expedite.description: Convert a standard requisition to a FAST supply path via premium shipping fees.
expedite.risk_note: Annual expedite budget is a visible line-item; repeat expedites flag the FSSG.

cross_level.description: Move a serviceable asset or part between subordinate units to balance readiness.

redistribute.description: Move an excess from one unit to fill a critical gap at another.

preposition_spares.description: Stage likely-failure spares before the SR opens, compressing time-to-effect.
preposition_spares.risk_note: Pre-positioning ties up budget; overspending shows up as unused stockage at the next ASL audit.

schedule_pm.description: Schedule overdue PMCS-B before the asset slips below MC.
schedule_pm.risk_note: PMCS slot is a fixed shop capacity — pre-empts other scheduled maintenance.

cross_level_proactive.description: Pre-stage a serviceable peer asset before the recipient deadlines.

lead_time_overrides._comment: Per-NSN overrides when real USMC lead-times are known to diverge from the SUPPLY_PATHS defaults. Format: NSN prefix â†’ (supply_path, mean_days, p90_days).

criticality_multipliers._comment: Applied on top of base lead time when the part is critical to mission essential equipment (MEL). Mission essential = 1.0x (no multiplier); Training = 1.3x; Admin = 1.6x.

convoy_feasibility._comment: Route-level feasibility for cross-level/redistribute actions. Distance in miles between installations; risk 1-5 (1 = garrison-to-garrison, 5 = deployed contested).
